name: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp
summary: Add image understanding to your app for about $0.22 per million input tokens off-peak, with a 1M-token context window. Experimental vision variant of V4 Flash, live on the API and OpenRouter now.

name: Firefly Audio
summary: Generate licensed music, voiceovers, and sound effects for your videos from text prompts — 45 voice profiles, a multitrack timeline, and clearance to use all of it commercially. Broadly available in Firefly now.

name: GPT-Image-2 transparent backgrounds
summary: Generate icons, stickers, and product shots as real alpha-channel PNGs by passing background=transparent — no background-removal step. Works in text-to-image, editing, and the Responses image tool, at no extra cost.

name: Qwen-UI-Agent
summary: Run a GUI agent locally that drives phones, desktops, and browsers by looking at the screen. Apache 2.0 weights in 8B and 2B sizes on Hugging Face, small enough for a consumer GPU.

name: Router
summary: Call OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, xAI, and Z.ai through one API and swap models without rewriting code. Dashboard tracks spend, latency, and fallbacks. Free through 2026 (you still pay inference), US only.

name: Berd
summary: Run a native desktop workspace for your AI agents — projects, skills, extensions, and local files in one place, with swappable model providers. Apache 2.0, on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

name: /design in Claude Code
summary: Type /design and get editable UI artboards that match your codebase's existing style — pick one, tweak it, then have Claude implement it. Research preview in the CLI and desktop app on Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise.

name: GLM-5.3
summary: Point your coding agent at the top-scoring open-weight model on Terminal-Bench, at roughly a sixth of frontier pricing. 744B MoE, 200K context. Live in the API now; weights land on Hugging Face around August 28.
